title: CoreTools Typewriter Extension
body: This extension is designed to let you use [CoreTools player variables](https://gitlab.com/ranetdev/CoreTools/-/wikis/features/variables) directly within [Typewriter](https://modrinth.com/plugin/typewriter) instead of using facts. Since CoreTools variables are player-based, they support multi-server setups. If the server is also using [MMOProfiles](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoprofiles/), both profile-based and real UUID-based variables can be used as well.! To install the extension, place the **.jar** file in the **plugins\Typewriter\extensions** folder.
